headline: O‘zbekistonliklar Xorvatiyada qurilish sohasida ishga taklif etilmoqda
summary: Uzbekistan's Migration Agency is recruiting construction workers and heavy-machinery drivers for jobs in Croatia, aged 25 to 45. The offer includes a monthly salary of €1,000, free housing and a meal allowance of €80 per month, with applications open until December 1.
why: Labour migration flows and remittances link source-country household incomes to construction sector labour supply in destination markets.
